subject: prd/read-to-rule
statement: When the reviewer signs a gate on a §0-bearing document, the sign-off record shall carry the capture line: minutes spent, and each feedback item marked in-§0 or outside-§0.
fit_criterion: every §0 gate in the window carries the line or stands as a recorded lineless miss — zero silent lineless gates; UB-4 voids lineless gates from metric arithmetic only
